mentions.name: Socratify
mentions.description: Socratify is a career skills AI coach that sharpens how users think and speak by having them debate AI, serving as an AI coach and sparring partner for skill building and reskilling for interviewing, onboarding, promotions, and career change.
mentions.problem: The workforce is on the verge of the largest white-collar skills dislocation ever, so skill building and reskilling need to be as effective as possible.
mentions.audience: White-collar workers building skills and reskilling for interviewing, onboarding, promotions, and career change.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Career Skills AI Coach. Sharpen how you think and speak by debating AI

We are clearly on the verge of the largest white-collar skills dislocation ever. Our goal at Socratify is to make skill building and reskilling for interviewing, onboarding, promotions, and career change as effective as possible with an AI coach and sparring partner.
